chapter: Liberty Band, marriage and the Depression
title: Octave's band: Washington, Bottler, Thomas Jefferson and the drummer
summary: Vincent lists the five-piece band under Octave, including Edmund Washington, Bottler, trumpeter Thomas Jefferson, and sorts out Black Happy from Black Benny as the drummer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
